continuity_scope: NIS America North American English original Ys IX: Monstrum Nox release witness: PS4 launch 2 February 2021, then Switch/PC/Stadia 6 July 2021. Character claims are limited to NIS America’s six named primary Monstrum cards. The 2023 PS5 release, any port-specific behavior, DLC/editions, all other Ys titles and their Adol-travelogue chronology, and unprofiled residents are separate.
work_or_witnesses: NIS America, Ys IX: Monstrum Nox official About/Characters page
NIS America, Ys IX: Monstrum Nox product page
NIS America, Ys IX: Monstrum Nox official System page
coverage_rule: All six named primary character cards in the selected NIS America main Characters panel: Adol, the White Cat, the Hawk, the Doll, the Renegade, and the Raging Bull. These are source-presented individual codenames, retained as canonical names within this narrow witness. Aprilis and all residents/secondary-character cards are excluded because they are outside this primary-card rule; real identities behind codenames are not inferred.
omissions: Aprilis, Dogi, and all secondary/resident profiles, real identities behind Monstrum codenames, unnamed Romun soldiers, collaborators, Lemures, factions, places, equipment, and mechanics as nodes.
All player party/skill/Gift/Boost/quest/collaborator states, outcomes, paths, the 2023 PS5 port, special editions/DLC, and other Ys titles/cross-title travelogue chronology.
Japanese/French and other localization variations, fan wikis, Wikipedia, walkthroughs, and community databases.
uncertainties: The six-card site identifies five Monstrums only by codenames and with promotional/rumor qualifiers; their real identities are intentionally not supplied.
The primary page’s 'fellow Monstrums' statement does not map each optional player party/skill configuration or later outcome.
The description calls Adol’s travelogues one hundred documents, but does not authorize reconstruction of a unified chronology across earlier Ys games.
evidence_basis: NIS America first-party English product, character, and system pages only. No fan source is used as canonical evidence.
